WITH _ctx AS (SELECT set_config('app.current_email', '{{ $json.body.email }}', false))
SELECT whatsfresh.f_account(whatsfresh.c_getval('account_id')::int) as account_name,
       whatsfresh.c_getval('first_name') as first_name,
       vp.page_title,
       vp.help_text
FROM _ctx, studio.vw_pages vp
WHERE page_id = whatsfresh.c_getval('page_id')::int
